answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond tied to a unique physical attestation, much as a glacier slowly accrues mass that cannot be forged overnight. Colluding identities are then cross-checked against a shared provenance graph, where anomalous clusters stand out as orchard amid tundra and are pruned before they can vote. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
